title: Treaty of Vienna (1866)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Vienna (1866)", at revision 1314820395, opens: "The 1866 Treaty of Vienna was an agreement signed on 3 October 1866 and ratified on 12 October by the Kingdom of Italy and the Austrian Empire that concluded the hostilities of the Third War of Italian Independence, a theatre of the concurrent Austro-Prussian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q474843, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Austro-Italian peace treaty, 1866". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
